description: This file defines the GenericEntity class, which handles persistence and data management for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting, getting, and manipulating entity fields, managing entity state, and integrating with the framework's model and delegator components.

classes.name: GenericEntity
classes.description: Represents a generic entity with persistence capabilities, field management, and change notification within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: NullGenericEntity
classes.description: A null object implementation of GenericEntity, immutable and representing a null entity.

classes.name: NullField
classes.description: A null object implementation of a field, with custom equality and comparison logic.

methods.name: createGenericEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericEntity with a specified model entity.

methods.name: refreshFromValue
methods.description: Updates the current entity's fields from another GenericEntity instance, ensuring primary key consistency.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field value by name, with optional null handling, including type conversion and observer notification.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a field value from a string, converting it to the appropriate type based on the entity's model.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array as a field value.

methods.name: setNextSeqId
methods.description: Generates and sets the next sequence ID for entities with a single primary key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field by name.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a field's value.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves a timestamp field value.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves a time field value.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves a date field value.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an integer field value.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long field value.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float field value.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double field value, with special handling for BigDecimal.

methods.name: getBigDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal field value.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a field, interpreting 'Y', 'T', 'N', 'F' strings.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns a TimeDuration object from a field, parsing string or number types.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set view of the entity's fields.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets a field value by key, delegating to the set method with null handling.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from a provided map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entity fields.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field by key.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of field names.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the entity has no fields.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of field values.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists among the fields.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of fields.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the entity matches a given EntityCondition.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for change notifications.

methods.name: clearChanged
methods.description: Clears the changed status.

methods.name: deleteObserver
methods.description: Removes a specific observer.

methods.name: deleteObservers
methods.description: Removes all observers.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the entity has been marked as changed.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all observers of changes.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies observers with an argument.

methods.name: setChanged
methods.description: Marks the entity as changed.

methods.name: originalDbValuesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if original database values are available.

methods.name: getOriginalDbValue
methods.description: Retrieves the original database value for a given field name.

methods.name: checkFks
methods.description: Verifies existence of foreign key records, optionally creating dummy records for missing FKs.
